quote: To evaluate, we use hit@1/2/3 accuracy, which calculates the percentage of predictions where the correct number word is ranked in the top k number words.

To estimate human performance on the task, we sampled 300 examples and asked two groups of three people to fill in the masked word, where one group had access to external information (openbook test) from the Web such as Wikipedia and the other did not (closed-book test). We take the majority label as the final human label.
